weakness_hunt.note: 4 of 10 observed listings carry fewer than 5 images, which is fewer than a buyer needs to judge a pattern they will never hold. Video and recurring complaints are measured where they have been observed and report unmeasurable where they have not. Deliverable clarity is now read too: 1 of 10 descriptions read state fewer than 60% of the facts that apply to them, and a description nobody has read is excluded rather than counted unclear

signals.complaints: recurring complaints in the reviews about the same thing
signals.limited_sizes: a garment or hat graded to two sizes or fewer, which most of the people who wanted it cannot make
signals.no_bundle: a department where almost nothing is sold as a set, so the buyer who wants two has to buy twice
signals.no_video: no video where the technique is the thing being sold
signals.thin_media: fewer images than a buyer needs to judge a pattern they cannot hold
signals.unclear_deliverable: the listing does not say what arrives, which is the most preventable refund in the category

sizes.reason: no observed listing is in a department where size is a variable, so a size range is not a weakness this catalogue can have
